adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and adds logic in `handleNewBooking.ts` to append additional hosts’ destination calendars for COLLECTIVE events (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`), and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now iterates over `event.destinationCalendar` to create events for each destination. However, `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts` still reconstructs `destinationCalendar` as only a single-element array based on `booking.destinationCalendar` or `user.destinationCalendar` (lines ~175-179 in the diff). Since the booking persistence also only connects `evt.destinationCalendar[0]` to `booking.destinationCalendar`, the confirmation path cannot recreate the full list of collective hosts’ calendars, so on confirmation it will only create a calendar event for that one destination calendar and miss other hosts.
